data.heading: Welcome to Youthup Foundation.
data.body:
At Youthup Foundation, we drive sustainable impact across Somalia by creating actionable pathways for the next generation to learn, grow, connect, and lead.

We work with high school students, university students, recent graduates, young professionals, young entrepreneurs, and youth seeking skills and opportunities.

## 1. Who we are

This website is run by Youthup Foundation ("Youthup", "we", "us"), a youth-focused organization based in Mogadishu, Somalia. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this website, why we collect it, and how we protect it.

## 2. Information we collect

We only collect information that you choose to send us:

- **Contact messages** — your name, and optionally your email, phone number, subject, and message.
- **Volunteer applications** — your name, email, phone, location, skills, interests, experience, availability, motivation, portfolio or LinkedIn link, and your CV if you upload one.
- **Mentor applications** — your name, email, phone, professional field, organization, years of experience, skills, areas you can mentor in, availability, short bio, motivation, website or LinkedIn link, and your CV if you upload one.
- **Partnership and sponsorship inquiries** — your organization's name, your name, email, phone, and message.
- **Donation pledges** — the details you enter on the donation form, such as your name, contact details, amount, payment method, and reference. We do not collect or store card numbers.
- **Newsletter sign-ups** — your email address and whether you are subscribed.

We do **not** offer visitor accounts. The only accounts on this website belong to authorized Youthup staff who manage its content.

## 3. How we use your information

- To read and reply to your messages.
- To review volunteer and mentor applications and contact applicants.
- To discuss partnerships, sponsorships, and donations.
- To send the newsletter, only if you subscribed.
- To keep the website secure and prevent spam and abuse.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.

## 4. Who can see your information

Only authorized Youthup staff can see the information you submit, and each staff role only sees what it needs (for example, applications are visible only to the staff who review them). CVs are stored privately and can only be opened by authorized staff through temporary, secure links.

We may share information if the law requires it, or with your permission (for example, introducing a mentor to a young person).

## 5. Where and how your information is stored

The website and its database are hosted by trusted service providers (Supabase for the database and file storage). Information is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access is protected by role-based security rules.

## 6. How long we keep it

We keep messages, applications, and inquiries only as long as needed to respond and to run our programs, after which they are archived or deleted. Newsletter subscribers can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.

## 7. Your rights

You can ask us to:

- tell you what information we hold about you,
- correct information that is wrong,
- delete your information,
- stop sending you the newsletter.

To make a request, use our [contact page](/contact).

## 8. Young people

Our work focuses on young people aged 15–35. If you are under 18, please ask a parent or guardian before sending us personal information.

## 9. Cookies

We only use cookies that are essential for the website to work and to remember your cookie choice. See our [Cookie Policy](/cookies) for details.

## 10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page.

## 11. Contact

If you have questions about this policy or your information, please [contact us](/contact).

## What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. They help a website work properly and can remember your choices.

## Cookies we use

We keep cookies to a minimum. Today, this website **only uses essential cookies** — we do not use advertising cookies, and we do not use analytics or tracking cookies.

| Cookie | Purpose | Type | How long |
|---|---|---|---|
| `yx_consent` | Remembers your cookie choice so we don't ask again | Essential | 12 months |
| `NEXT_LOCALE` | Remembers the website language | Essential | Session / 12 months |
| `sb-…-auth-token` | Keeps authorized staff signed in to the admin area (staff only) | Essential | Session |
| `yx_admin` | Confirms a secure staff sign-in (staff only) | Essential | Session |

Essential cookies are needed for the website to work and to keep it secure, so they cannot be switched off.

## Your choices

When you first visit, we ask you to choose:

- **Accept all cookies** — allows essential cookies and any optional cookies we may add in the future (for example, privacy-friendly visitor statistics).
- **Essential cookies only** — only the cookies the website needs to work.
- **Reject all** — refuses every optional cookie. Essential cookies stay on because the website cannot work without them.

You can change your choice at any time using the **Cookie settings** link at the bottom of every page. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

## Changes

If we ever add optional cookies, we will update this page and only use them with your consent.

## Contact

Questions about cookies? Please [contact us](/contact).
